final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The bug was in `vendor/slugify/index.js`, which deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters vanished. That folder is marked "do not edit by hand", so I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. `postSlug` now removes the accents before calling slugify.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the same vendored slugify directly, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone to keep the change small. The same fix would apply there if you want it.
